home_about_p1: DragonSword: Awakening is an anime open-world action RPG developed by Hound13 and built on Unreal Engine 5. Set on the Continent of Orbis, players control protagonist Lute and recruit 18 additional heroes, each with unique Status Ailment abilities.
home_about_p2: The game features a tag combo battle system where 3-hero teams fight in real-time, stacking Status Ailments to trigger Signal Skills and Switching Signals. Originally a Korean mobile gacha game, Hound13 completely rebuilt it as a buy-to-play PC title with no gacha elements — all 19 heroes are included in the base purchase.
home_feature_tagCombos_desc: Switch between 3 heroes in real-time. Stack Status Ailments across your team to trigger Signal Skills and devastating Switching Signal chains.
home_feature_noGacha_desc: All 19 heroes included in the base purchase. No pay-to-win, no gacha pulls. Only cosmetic Familiar DLC available.
home_feature_nineteenHeroes_desc: Each hero has unique Status Ailment abilities, elements, and faction affiliations. Build your perfect 3-hero tag team.

faq_isGacha: Is DragonSword: Awakening a gacha game?
faq_isGacha_answer: No. DragonSword: Awakening was originally a Korean mobile gacha game, but Hound13 completely rebuilt it as a buy-to-play PC game. All 19 heroes are included in the $29.99 purchase. There are no gacha pulls or pay-to-win mechanics. Only cosmetic Familiar DLC is available.
faq_bestHeroes: Who are the best heroes in DragonSword: Awakening?
faq_bestHeroes_answer: S-tier heroes include Lute (Knockdown DPS), Aria (Shock Support), Castella (Airborne CC), and Dana (Freeze Tank). These heroes offer the best Status Ailment coverage and combo potential. Check our full Tier List for detailed rankings.
faq_tagComboHow: How does the tag combo system work?
faq_tagComboHow_answer: The tag combo system lets you switch between 3 heroes in real-time during combat. Each hero applies a Status Ailment (Knockdown, Shock, Freeze, Airborne, or Bleed). When ailments stack, they trigger Signal Skills and Switching Signals for bonus damage. Combining different ailments across heroes creates powerful chain combos.
faq_familiarFree: Are DLC Familiars stronger than free ones?
faq_familiarFree_answer: No. According to official sources, there is no functional difference between free and DLC Familiars. The 20 free Familiars obtained through story and exploration provide the same combat and exploration bonuses as the 10 DLC Familiars.
faq_dlcContent_answer: DLC consists entirely of Familiar cosmetics — 10 Familiars available as DLC with no functional advantage over free Familiars. All 19 heroes and core gameplay content are included in the base $29.99 purchase. Post-launch hero updates (Liza, Jerome, Veronica, Logan) will be free.
faq_priceModel_answer: DragonSword: Awakening is buy-to-play at $29.99. There is no gacha, no pay-to-win, and no subscription. All 19 heroes are included. Only cosmetic Familiar DLC is available for purchase. Purchase before August 31, 2026 to receive the free Abyssal Direwolf Familiar bonus.
faq_legalDispute: What is the Webzen legal dispute about?
faq_legalDispute_answer: Hound13 had a contract dispute with former publisher Webzen regarding the original Korean mobile version. The dispute is still in legal proceedings but does not affect the PC release of DragonSword: Awakening. Hound13 is now self-publishing the PC version.
faq_howManyHeroes: How many heroes are in the game?
faq_howManyHeroes_answer: There are 19 playable heroes at launch, with 4 additional heroes (Liza, Jerome, Veronica, Logan) planned for post-launch updates as free additions. All heroes are included in the base purchase — no unlocking or gacha required.
faq_signalSkill: What are Signal Skills and Switching Signals?
faq_signalSkill_answer: Signal Skills are powerful bonus attacks triggered when Status Ailments stack during tag combos. Switching Signals are special attacks triggered when you switch heroes at the right moment during a combo chain. Together, they form the core damage-dealing mechanic of the tag combo system.
faq_riftSystem_answer: The Rift System is a planned endgame content feature coming in post-launch updates. Details are limited, but it is expected to provide challenging repeatable content for max-level heroes. Check our Updates page for the latest roadmap information.

category_mechanics_heroes: Each hero has a primary Status Ailment that they apply through attacks. When ailments from different heroes stack on the same enemy, they trigger Signal Skills — powerful bonus attacks that deal massive damage. Switching between heroes at the right moment triggers Switching Signals, creating chain combos that can decimate even the toughest bosses. The Frost Gauge mechanic (for freeze heroes) fills progressively before triggering a full freeze.
category_advantages_heroes: A diverse hero roster lets you build tag teams for any situation. S-tier heroes provide the best ailment coverage and combo potential. Faction synergies (Red Fox Mercenaries, Organa Order) provide bonus effects when heroes from the same faction are on the same team. All 19 heroes are included in the base purchase — no gacha or unlocking required.
category_weaknesses_heroes: Some heroes have narrow ailment coverage, making them less versatile in certain team compositions. C-tier heroes like Charlotte require more skill investment to be effective. Some ailment combinations (e.g., double Bleed) have diminishing returns compared to diverse ailment teams. Hero data is based on pre-release testing and may shift after launch.

category_faq_heroes_a_1: Yes. Heroes from the same faction (Red Fox Mercenaries or Organa Order) gain synergy bonuses when on the same team. Red Fox teams tend to be more offense-oriented, while Organa teams offer more control and support options.

category_intro_tag-combos: The Tag Combo system is the core combat mechanic of DragonSword: Awakening. You control a 3-hero team in real-time, switching between heroes to stack Status Ailments and trigger devastating Signal Skills and Switching Signals. Mastering tag combos is essential for clearing challenging content.

category_mechanics_tag-combos: The tag combo system works through Status Ailment stacking. When Hero A applies their ailment and you switch to Hero B who applies a different ailment, the combination triggers a Signal Skill — a powerful bonus attack. Switching at the precise moment during a combo triggers a Switching Signal for extra damage. The key is maintaining ailment uptime across all three heroes.
category_advantages_tag-combos: Tag combos provide the highest DPS ceiling in the game. A well-executed 3-hero chain can deal 3-5x more damage than single-hero combat. The system rewards mastery — players who understand ailment interactions and switching timing will dramatically outperform those who don't.
category_weaknesses_tag-combos: The system has a learning curve — QTE button timing and switch animations require practice. Some players in the Demo reported that QTE inputs felt unintuitive. Missing a switch window breaks the combo chain and loses DPS. Certain ailment combinations have anti-synergy (e.g., Airborne + Bleed doesn't stack well).
category_faq_tag-combos_q_0: How do I trigger a Switching Signal?
category_faq_tag-combos_a_0: Switch heroes at the precise moment when the current hero's attack animation reaches its combo point. The window is tight — practice the timing in easier content first. Successful Switching Signals deal bonus damage and continue the ailment chain.

category_intro_status-ailments: Status Ailments are the foundation of DragonSword: Awakening's combat system. The five core ailments — Knockdown, Shock, Freeze, Airborne, and Bleed — each create unique combat interactions. When ailments stack across heroes, they trigger Signal Skills and Switching Signals that form the game's devastating combo chains.

category_mechanics_status-ailments: Each Status Ailment has a specific trigger condition and duration. Knockdown and Shock are immediate-impact ailments that create combo windows. Freeze uses a Frost Gauge that fills progressively before triggering. Airborne launches enemies for juggle follow-ups. Bleed is the only DOT ailment, stacking for increased tick damage. When two different ailments are active on the same enemy, a Signal Skill automatically triggers.
category_advantages_status-ailments: Understanding ailment interactions is the key to high-level play. Knockdown+Shock creates the longest stun window. Freeze+Airborne triggers a shatter effect for bonus burst. Diverse ailment teams (3 different ailments) maintain the highest Signal Skill uptime. Boss-specific resistances make ailment diversity essential.
category_weaknesses_status-ailments: Bosses have ailment resistances — some are immune to specific ailments. Stack diminishing returns apply when the same ailment is applied twice. Bleed is the weakest ailment for combo chains since it doesn't trigger immediate Signal Skills. The Frost Gauge mechanic requires sustained application before freezing, making it timing-dependent.
category_faq_status-ailments_a_0: Yes. Bosses have varying resistances to different ailments. Very Hard dungeon bosses may be immune to certain ailments entirely. This is why diverse ailment coverage across your 3-hero team is essential — you need backup options when your primary ailment is resisted.

category_intro_exploration: The Continent of Orbis is a vast open world filled with hidden caves, deep sea areas, Familiar habitats, and valuable crafting materials. Exploration rewards players with rare items, Familiar encounters, and lore fragments that enrich the game's narrative.
category_mechanics_exploration: The open world is divided into distinct regions with unique environments — grasslands, deep seas, mountains, and underground cave networks. Familiars are found in specific habitats tied to their element type. Hidden caves contain rare materials and lore items. The day/night cycle affects certain Familiar appearances and enemy spawns.
category_advantages_exploration: Thorough exploration yields powerful crafting materials, Familiar companions, and Nameless Soul currency. Hidden areas often contain lore fragments that reveal the history of the Six Heroes. Familiar collection rewards are permanent — once collected, they provide ongoing bonuses.
category_weaknesses_exploration: Some hidden areas require specific heroes or ailments to access (e.g., frozen paths need Freeze heroes). Material farming can be time-consuming. The deep sea areas have navigation challenges. Some Familiar locations are only available during specific conditions (time of day, weather).
category_faq_exploration_q_0: How do I find hidden caves?
category_faq_exploration_a_0: Look for environmental clues — cracked walls (breakable with Knockdown heroes), frozen waterfalls (passable with Freeze heroes), and elevated platforms (reachable with Airborne heroes). Our exploration guide has a complete map of all hidden locations.

category_intro_familiars: Familiars are companion creatures that assist heroes in combat and exploration across the Continent of Orbis. There are 30 Familiars total — 20 obtainable for free through story and exploration, and 10 available as DLC. Importantly, there is no functional difference between free and DLC Familiars.
category_mechanics_familiars: Each Familiar provides a passive bonus — combat boosts, exploration aids, healing auras, or detection abilities. Familiars are assigned to heroes and provide their bonuses during combat and exploration. Multiple Familiars can be collected but only one is active per hero at a time. The Abyssal Direwolf is a limited-time bonus for purchases before August 31.
category_advantages_familiars: Familiars enhance hero performance without requiring gacha — all free Familiars are functionally equivalent to DLC ones. Combat Familiars boost tag combo damage and ailment effectiveness. Exploration Familiars reveal hidden items and speed up travel. Familiar collection is a rewarding side activity.
category_weaknesses_familiars: Only one Familiar can be active per hero. Some Familiar locations are missable if specific story choices are made. DLC Familiars are cosmetic-only but some players may feel obligated to purchase for collection completion. Familiar abilities are passive and cannot be directly controlled.
category_faq_familiars_q_0: Are DLC Familiars better than free ones?
category_faq_familiars_a_0: No. Official sources confirm there is no functional difference between free and DLC Familiars. Both provide the same types of bonuses. DLC Familiars are purely cosmetic alternatives — they look different but perform the same.

about_gameP1: DragonSword: Awakening is an anime open-world action RPG developed by Hound13 Inc. and built on Unreal Engine 5. Set on the Continent of Orbis, players control protagonist Lute and recruit 18 additional heroes, each with unique Status Ailment abilities.
about_gameP2: The game features a tag combo battle system where 3-hero teams fight in real-time, stacking Status Ailments to trigger Signal Skills and Switching Signals. Originally a Korean mobile gacha game, Hound13 completely rebuilt it as a buy-to-play PC title with no gacha elements. Available on Steam from July 23, 2026.

category_mechanics_buying-guide: DragonSword: Awakening uses a buy-to-play model at $29.99 on Steam. The base edition includes all 19 playable heroes with no additional purchase required. DLC consists entirely of cosmetic Familiar companions — 10 Familiars available as DLC with no functional advantage over the 20 free Familiars. A pre-order bonus (free Abyssal Direwolf Familiar) is available for purchases before August 31, 2026. All post-launch hero updates will be free, continuing the no-gacha philosophy.
category_advantages_buying-guide: At $29.99, DragonSword: Awakening offers exceptional value — all 19 heroes included with no gacha, no pay-to-win, and no subscription. Compared to gacha RPGs where unlocking all characters can cost hundreds of dollars, the buy-to-play model saves players significant money. DLC Familiars are purely cosmetic, so free players have full gameplay parity.
category_weaknesses_buying-guide: The $29.99 price point is higher than free-to-play alternatives, which may deter some players. No physical edition has been announced — digital only on Steam. The Webzen legal dispute may concern some buyers, though it does not affect the PC release. DLC Familiars exist for collectionists who want all 30, though they provide no gameplay advantage.
category_faq_buying-guide_q_0: Is the base edition enough to enjoy the full game?
category_faq_buying-guide_a_0: Yes. The $29.99 base edition includes all 19 heroes, the complete story, all regions, and 20 free Familiars. DLC Familiars are cosmetic only — there is no gameplay content locked behind additional purchases.
category_faq_buying-guide_a_1: Purchasing DragonSword: Awakening before August 31, 2026 grants the Abyssal Direwolf Familiar for free. This Familiar provides a combat boost that enhances tag combo damage. After the deadline, it may become a paid DLC item.
category_faq_buying-guide_q_2: Will I need to spend more after buying the base game?
category_faq_buying-guide_a_2: No. All gameplay content — heroes, story, dungeons, and the upcoming Rift System — is included. The only optional purchases are cosmetic Familiar DLC, which provide no functional advantage over free Familiars.

category_mechanics_cooking-crafting: Cooking lets you prepare meals from gathered ingredients that provide temporary stat boosts — increased attack power, defense, ailment duration, or movement speed. Crafting produces items essential for exploration, such as climbing gear, torches, and breathing apparatuses for deep sea areas. Recipes are discovered through NPC interactions, Hero Request quests, and exploration of hidden areas. Some rare recipes require materials from multiple regions of Orbis.
category_advantages_cooking-crafting: Cooked meals provide significant combat advantages before challenging boss fights and dungeons. Stat boosts stack with hero build bonuses for maximum effect. Crafting items unlock access to otherwise inaccessible exploration areas. Hidden recipes offer unique bonuses not available through any other means. Gathering ingredients doubles as exploration rewards.
category_weaknesses_cooking-crafting: Meal buffs are temporary and must be reapplied before each challenge. Rare ingredients can be time-consuming to farm, especially those in deep sea or hidden cave areas. Some recipes have prerequisite quest completion requirements. Crafting materials compete with Familiar collection for exploration time.
category_faq_cooking-crafting_q_0: How do I find new recipes?
category_faq_cooking-crafting_a_0: Recipes are discovered through three main sources: NPC interactions in towns and villages, Hero Request quests that reward cooking recipes, and exploration of hidden caves and remote areas. Some rare recipes are only available after completing specific story chapters.
category_faq_cooking-crafting_q_1: Do meal buffs stack with hero build bonuses?
category_faq_cooking-crafting_a_1: Yes. Meal stat boosts stack multiplicatively with build bonuses and Familiar bonuses. This makes cooking especially valuable before Very Hard dungeons and boss encounters where every advantage counts.
category_faq_cooking-crafting_q_2: What are the most important meals to cook?
category_faq_cooking-crafting_a_2: Attack Power and Ailment Duration meals are the most valuable for combat. Movement Speed meals help during exploration. The rare Dragon's Breath meal, found in a hidden volcano cave, provides the highest overall stat boost in the game.

category_faq_status-ailments_q_1: What happens when the same ailment is applied twice?
category_faq_status-ailments_a_1: Stacking the same ailment on the same enemy has diminishing returns. The second application extends the duration slightly but does not double the effect. Diverse ailment teams (different ailments per hero) are always more effective than stacking the same ailment twice.
category_faq_status-ailments_q_2: Which ailment is best for beginners?
category_faq_status-ailments_a_2: Knockdown is the most beginner-friendly — it creates long combo windows and pairs well with every other ailment. Lute (Knockdown) is available from the start and has a straightforward DPS rotation. Once you understand timing, add Shock from Aria for the powerful Knockdown+Shock Signal Skill.

category_mechanics_story-lore: The narrative of DragonSword: Awakening centers on the Dragon Prophecy — an ancient foretelling of the Dragon's resurrection that will reshape the Continent of Orbis. Lute, the protagonist, leads the Red Fox Mercenaries against the Organa Order, who seek to harness the Dragon's power for their own ends. The Six Heroes of Legend — ancient warriors who once sealed the Dragon — left behind lore fragments scattered across hidden caves and dungeons. Character relationships and faction choices affect story outcomes and unlock exclusive side content.
category_advantages_story-lore: The story provides meaningful context for gameplay — understanding the Six Heroes' history reveals why certain areas contain specific Familiars and materials. Faction choices unlock exclusive quests and Familiar encounters. Lore fragments found in exploration offer powerful crafting recipes. The narrative ties directly into the tag combo system through the legend of the heroes' combined techniques.
category_weaknesses_story-lore: Some story content requires specific faction alignment choices that cannot be reversed, potentially locking players out of certain quests and Familiar encounters. Lore is scattered across hidden areas that can be easily missed during normal play. The Webzen legal dispute has created some narrative discontinuity with the original Korean mobile version's story. Pre-release lore details may change in the final launch version.
category_faq_story-lore_a_0: Yes. Choosing between the Red Fox Mercenaries and Organa Order alignment affects which side quests and Familiar encounters are available. Red Fox quests tend to offer offense-oriented rewards, while Organa quests provide control and support items. Some Familiars are exclusive to one faction's questline.
category_faq_story-lore_q_1: Who are the Six Heroes of Legend?
category_faq_story-lore_a_1: The Six Heroes of Legend are ancient warriors who sealed the Dragon away centuries before the events of the game. Their lore fragments are scattered across hidden caves and dungeons. Collecting all fragments reveals their true identities and unlocks a powerful crafting recipe related to the Dragon's power.
category_faq_story-lore_q_2: Does the story connect to the original Korean mobile game?
category_faq_story-lore_a_2: Only loosely. Hound13 completely rebuilt the narrative for the PC version. The core characters and the Dragon Prophecy concept remain, but the story, world design, and gameplay systems are entirely new. The original mobile version's gacha mechanics and story have been removed.

category_mechanics_system-requirements: DragonSword: Awakening runs on Unreal Engine 5, which demands capable hardware for smooth open-world performance. The game requires a 64-bit OS, DirectX 12 support, and an SSD is strongly recommended for asset streaming. Minimum specs target 30 FPS at low settings, while recommended specs target 60 FPS at high settings with stable performance. The game supports 11 languages with full text localization.
category_advantages_system-requirements: UE5 delivers stunning visual quality with dynamic lighting and detailed environments. The game supports a wide range of hardware configurations from budget to high-end PCs. SSD storage dramatically improves load times and open-world streaming. The 11-language support makes the game accessible to a global audience.
category_weaknesses_system-requirements: UE5 is demanding — players with older hardware may struggle with framerate issues in open-world areas. The ~60GB storage requirement is significant. Some UE5 titles have reported shader compilation stuttering at launch. Performance optimization may improve over time with patches but could be rough at release.
category_faq_system-requirements_q_0: Can I run the game on a GTX 1060?
category_faq_system-requirements_a_0: The GTX 1060 is likely below minimum requirements for smooth gameplay. UE5 open-world games typically require at least a GTX 1070 or equivalent for 30 FPS at low settings. Consider upgrading to an RTX 3060 or better for a comfortable experience.
category_faq_system-requirements_a_1: Technically no, but it is strongly recommended. UE5 open-world games stream assets constantly, and an HDD will cause noticeable pop-in, longer load times, and potential stuttering. An SSD provides a dramatically smoother experience.
category_faq_system-requirements_a_2: No console versions have been announced. DragonSword: Awakening is currently a PC (Steam) exclusive. Hound13 has not ruled out console ports in the future, but there is no official timeline.

category_faq_tier-list_q_1: Is Charlotte viable despite being C-tier?
category_faq_tier-list_a_1: Charlotte can be effective with significant investment. Her Airborne chains are extended compared to other Airborne heroes, allowing longer juggle combos. She requires more skill and team support than higher-tier heroes but can hold her own in the right composition.
category_faq_tier-list_q_2: How often is the tier list updated?
category_faq_tier-list_a_2: The tier list is based on pre-release community testing and will be updated as the meta develops after launch. Expect the first major revision within weeks of release as players discover optimal strategies. New heroes and the Rift System will prompt further updates.
